plan: A giant catfish who swallows his enemies or allies to carry them off or protect them.
aSurveiller: His R (Devour). He swallows a champion to carry them off: if he has already hit you 3 times, he can swallow you.
contrer: Avoid taking 3 hits from him: he can then swallow you (R).
His E protects him: wait until he has used it to attack him.
Percent health damage is effective against him.
forces: Can save an ally by swallowing them.
Strong in duels in the early game.

sorts.P: His health increases his damage; stacks marks.
sorts.E: Stores damage and converts it into a shield.
sorts.R: Swallows an enemy or allied champion.
